question: How should measurements be named in the Measurements panel and spec list?
context: The redline mock panel shows semantic names (Save Changes / width, Row gap / Appearance, Field to button gap). A screenshot has no UI tree, so semantic names require OCR. Names also feed the Copy as spec list export. Spec: docs/design/next-measure.md section 6.

options.label: Derived names + inline rename
options.detail: Rows default to axis word + value (Width 128 px, Gap 16 px); double-click a row to rename. Simple, offline, testable in core.

options.label: Semantic names via text recognition
options.detail: Use Vision text recognition near the measured element to build names like the mock (Save Changes / width). App-layer only, falls back to derived names when no text is found; more magic, more wrong-name risk.

options.label: Values only, no names
options.detail: Rows and the spec list show just role + value. Least work, but a 20-row spec list becomes hard to read.
